However, a small study2 of serum vitamin D concentrations in patients with rheumatoid arthritis who had donated blood before the onset of symptoms, found no associa- tion between vitamin D deficiency and later development of rheumatoid arthritis, suggesting that vitamin D does not have an important role in the pathogenesis of rheumatoid arthritis. 1.
